evidence_plan.requirement: Different correlations of ROUGE variants with human judgments
Effectiveness of ROUGE variants in scientific summarization

payload.reason: The evidence provides insights into how different ROUGE variants correlate with human judgments and their effectiveness in scientific summarization.

claims.text: Different variants of ROUGE result in different correlation values with human judgments, with ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-3 showing better correlations in scientific summarization.
ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L have weak correlations with human pyramid scores, while higher-order n-grams like ROUGE-3 correlate better.
The effectiveness of ROUGE as an evaluation metric for scientific summarization is challenged due to weak correlations with manual evaluations.
